actions.name: death throes
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=jTq2czA8KQITUK4c]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=jTq2czA8KQITUK4c]]-foot Emanation originating from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. Failure or Success: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies outside the Abyss, it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

actions.name: fire aura
actions.desc: At the end of each of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s turns, each [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=15VgJKVXwYBOFSqJ]] of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s choice in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=15VgJKVXwYBOFSqJ]]-foot Emanation originating from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes [[/damage average]] damage.

actions.name: legendary resistance
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: magic resistance
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes one [[/item .mmFlameWhip00000]] attack and one [[/item .mmLightningBlade]] attack.

actions.name: flame whip
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} pulls the target up to 25 feet straight toward itself, and the target has the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition.

actions.name: teleport
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} teleports [[lookup @target.affects.special activity=dnoRMdFzhUUku26D]] of itself up to [[lookup @range.value activity=dnoRMdFzhUUku26D]] feet to an unoccupied space the  [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see.

actions.name: lightning blade
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]], and the target can't take &Reference[Reaction] until the start of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn.
